title: Paired seed replication of the SW0106 shared RGB reconstruction assignment-credit recipe

historical_context.SW0106: The original seed-0 expansion gate failed and remains unchanged. Posthoc reviewed seed-0 paired-image evidence motivates this separate seed-1/2 replication; it does not retroactively promote SW0106.
historical_context.source: SW0095 source checkpoint for each seed; SW0097 seed-specific frozen controls are used only to verify source/order/budget registration.
historical_context.selection_evidence: SW0106 results_archive/posthoc_replication_evidence_20261009.json; seed0 candidate/source and candidate/control FG-ARI and matched-object-IoU paired-image intervals were positive.

arms.candidate: legacy phase + 5 * positive-product actual-spike QCC + fixed_lambda * hard-H RGB assignment reconstruction
arms.control: same legacy phase + 5 * positive-product actual-spike QCC; RGB decoder reconstruction has no assignment credit to core/encoder

source_and_data.global_id_mapping: pool indices 0..999 map identically; indices 1000..69999 map to global IDs 1640..70639
source_and_data.train_cache: SW0106 registered RGB train cache, full physical shape [70000,128,128,3]

fixed_recipe.warmup_scope: seed-specific decoder warmup and Adam moments; source core and encoder frozen
fixed_recipe.lambda_source: original passed SW0106 seed-0 preflight, copied byte-for-byte to this experiment; seed-1/2 calibration ratios are diagnostic only and never replace lambda
fixed_recipe.objective: preserve SW0106 objective and exact hard-QCC straight-through RGB assignment loss; no teacher or ground-truth mask supervision

evaluation.readout: unchanged native actual-spike QCC; threshold .50; minimum group size 2; largest-component background

paired_image_bootstrap.resampling: same 320 image indices across all three training seeds
paired_image_bootstrap.rng: NumPy RandomState (MT19937), seed 129; common resampled image indices across the three training seeds

promotion_gate.seed0: Reuse the original SW0106 seed-0 candidate, control, and source97 per-image results; do not retrain seed0.
promotion_gate.failure: Report all seeds and metrics; no threshold, lambda, learning-rate, seed, epoch, or data-size tuning.

interpretation_limit: Passing supports replication of RGB assignment credit under this recipe only. It does not prove independent gating contributions, 70k scaling, or from-scratch data scaling.
